result: New focusa-pty crate: governed Attachment identity (fail-closed project-scope validation) and PtyRegistry — one persistent Pi process per governed Attachment, duplicate attach idempotent (same Arc returned), detach keeps the live process (view switches never kill), close kills, restart respawns under a fresh generation.
